arcs.title: The Subcommittee's Jurisdiction Problem
arcs.summary: Day 1: The Subcommittee on Unmapped Geographical Features has opened a jurisdiction claim over the Room above Marker 9, insisting it must be mapped, named, and assigned an eleven-digit reference number. The Room has not responded to any owl. The Subcommittee has interpreted silence as consent. Christine is aware of this and has not yet decided whether to engage. Day 2 should establish the Subcommittee's increasingly elaborate bureaucratic overreach — perhaps a formal mapping party proposed, or a request for Christine and Steve to submit a witness statement about the Room's interior — while Christine and the Room continue to decline to cooperate on anyone else's timeline.
